notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Content Update
[olist]
Added new boss: Moose God

Added new elite monster: Feathered Serpent

Added card "Link Break" — Use this card to break links! All starter decks now include one copy. Additional copies can be obtained during your journey (if needed).

Adjusted the \[Charge] mechanic: Units will now reverse direction after reaching the end of the board (preventing deadlocks when both Lords have \[Charge]).
[/olist]
Balance Updates
[olist]
Ape God now generates only 1 Banana per turn.

Black Turtle cost increased by 1.

Swordmaster stats after upgrade adjusted to 4/7 (increased).
[/olist]
Bug Fixes

Fixed a bunch of bugs.

Optimizations & Visual Improvements

Polished various details and visuals.
